$comment: Departure rules of the three travel plans (H8.1.1). Departure day is G-n; time is local. Standard: afternoon of G-1 after a morning walkthrough. Early: G-2 after practice; the G-1 walkthrough is held at the destination. Extended: G-4 or earlier with host-site practice. Times are Assumption (H8.1.2 rule 1 gives the order of the travel day, not clock times). returnAfterGameMinutes is the gap from final whistle to departure home (Assumption).
